serverNotReady.where: Setlist actions (delete, notify band, public print): Error toast/message when the server's database connection is not initialised (rare, transient).

setlistNotFound.where: Setlist actions (delete, rename, print, email, notify band, transfer): error when the setlist no longer exists

deleteOwnerOrAdminOnly.where: Setlist editor / dashboard: error when deleting someone else's setlist
deleteOwnerOrAdminOnly.context: 'owner' = the person who created the setlist

ownerOrLeaderRequired.where: Setlist: error when emailing personal packets without permission

atLeastOneMusician.where: Notify-band dialog: error when no musicians were selected to notify

ownerLeaderOrAdminRequired.where: Notify-band / resend-email: error when the user may not notify the band about this setlist

needsLinkedChart.where: Notify-band dialog: error when no song in the setlist has a chart attached

setlistIdRequired.where: Setlist print (packet download): error when the link names no setlist (developer error)

packetFailed.where: Public setlist packet download: error when the PDF packet could not be built
packetFailed.context: 'packet' = the PDF bundle of all charts in the setlist

chartsOmitted.where: Print / gig packet: error dialog when some charts could not be added to the PDF packet (user may print anyway)

renameNotAllowed.where: Setlist editor: error when renaming a setlist without permission

invalidRequestSetlistId.where: Resend email: error when the request named no setlist (developer error)

noEmailRecipients.where: Resend email: error when none of the setlist's musicians has an email address

resendFailed.where: Resend email: error when sending the emails failed

transferUserNotFound.where: Transfer setlist (admin): error when no account has the given email
transferUserNotFound.context: {email} is the email address that was typed

transferred.context: {setlistName} is the setlist's name (in quotes); {email} is the new owner's email
